questions.prompt: Name two strategy families in Gross's process model.
questions.answer: Any two of situation selection/modification, attentional deployment, cognitive change and response modulation.

questions.prompt: Is emotion regulation identical to reducing all emotions?
questions.answer: No; it concerns influencing experience, timing or expression in relation to goals.
questions.feedback: Name a goal other than calmness.

questions.answer: Context, goals and feedback can change which strategies are suitable.

questions.prompt: What should take priority in immediate danger?
questions.feedback: Do not substitute a coping exercise.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only. Use answer-specific feedback and delayed retest.
scoring.practice: Compares regulation options across contexts, selects proportionate strategies and identifies feedback and safety limits.
scoring.transfer: Use the matrix for two fictional cases: an ordinary disagreement with a flexible deadline and an urgent legitimate responsibility. Select different strategy mixes, state why and identify feedback that would prompt a revision.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
